source: High-intensity kernels reuse data enough that arithmetic throughput can become the limiting ceiling. Lowintensity kernels move many bytes for relatively little computation and are more likely to be constrained by memory bandwidth. The exact boundary depends on the hardware.[13]
zh: 高强度内核重复使用数据足够多，以至于算术吞吐量可能成为限制上限。低强度内核移动大量字节以进行相对较少的计算，并且更可能受到内存带宽的限制。确切的边界取决于硬件。[13]
